question:
Study the following bar chart and answer the question

Sales of XYZ Phones over the years 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9178e8bdc9c320f9e0ded7023014a34ad72b318368d2601a06addff6d33ca92c.png] 

Find the percentage increase of sales of XYZ phones from 2019 to 2020? (Rounded up to 2 decimal places)
solution:
**Calculation:**

Sale of XYZ mobile in 2019 = 18

Sale of XYZ mobile in 2020 = 40

Percentage increase = (22 × 100)/18 = 1100/9 = 122.22%

**∴ The correct answer is 122.22%.**
